# Kids Qur'an

> Kids Qur'an is a free, browser-based app that helps children memorise parts of the Qur'an, made by Ummah Apps. URL: https://kids-quran.ummahapps.ai/

## What it does

- Surahs: Al-Fatiha, Ayatul Kursi, Al-Asr, Al-Kafirun, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas, Al-Kawthar and Al-Insan. Al-Insan is learned in three parts that unlock in turn.
- Recitation by Sheikh Saad al-Ghamdi.
- Repeat each part 1, 3, 5 or 10 times, or play everything in order.
- Play slowly, hide the words to test yourself, and show the English translation.
- Colour themes children can choose.
- Free, with no sign-up.

## Links

- App: https://kids-quran.ummahapps.ai/
